items.title: Reliance Industries Q2 results today: Can the old economy rescue the new Reliance?
items.description: Reliance Industries is poised to reveal its Q2 earnings, with anticipation surrounding a notable profit revival in its oil-to-chemicals division. Analysts forecast a rise in consolidated EBITDA, supported by enhanced refining margins and solid petrochemical performance. Jio Platforms should offer consistent contributions, though Reliance Retail may face pressures with shrinking margins. Investors will keep a watchful eye on insights regarding future expansion in new energy ventures.

items.title: Trent net profit up 25% despite cost pressures and stiff competition
items.description: Tata's Trent retailer reported significant financial success, posting a 25% rise in net profit, which hit ₹468 crore for the quarter ending in September. The company's revenue jumped by 22%, reaching ₹5,873 crore. While geopolitical instabilities and inflation posed challenges, Trent executed strategic sourcing initiatives and expanded its presence by opening 29 new locations, consolidating its portfolio and reflecting a positive consumer outlook in the retail sector.

items.title: Godrej consumer profit rises 14%, weighs calibrated price hikes to offset inflation
items.description: Godrej Consumer Products is bracing for rising commodity inflation as it approaches the December quarter, driven by escalating costs. The firm expects to raise prices on soaps and liquid detergents to sustain its growth trajectory. Aasif Malbari, the chief, mentioned a significant single-digit inflationary effect on operations in India and Indonesia.

items.title: Coal India reports 57% rise in net profit to Rs 6,547 crore in Q2
items.description: Coal India Ltd reported a significant increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September. The company's net profit reached ₹6,547 crore, up from ₹4,167 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations grew to ₹44,179 crore, driven by higher product sales as total income also increased. Total expenditure for the period rose to ₹38,398 crore due to various costs.

items.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 profit up 1.3%, revenue rises 26%
items.description: Suzlon Energy has announced a 1.3% increase in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27 compared to the previous year. This growth in revenue is attributed to a surge in wind turbine deliveries, resulting in a total of 710 MW delivered in this quarter versus 565 MW from last year.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp bets on premiumisation, EVs to sustain growth momentum
items.description: Hero MotoCorp has seen notable revenue growth in the September quarter, buoyed by soaring sales volumes. The company's market share climbed to 7.3%, thanks to heightened demand for scooters and VIDA electric vehicle sales. With plans for new premium motorcycle launches and an expansion of EV production, Hero anticipates a revival in international markets, projecting growth in exports for the latter half of FY27.

items.title: IndiGo posts Rs 1,879-crore loss as high fuel costs, geopolitical woes hit; capacity cuts & yield management offer only partial relief, says CEO Willie Walsh
items.description: IndiGo reported a net loss of Rs 1,879 crore in the September quarter as a sharp rise in jet fuel prices and foreign exchange costs offset strong revenue growth. While revenue increased 26% year-on-year to Rs 23,363.8 crore, fuel costs surged more than 67%. The airline plans to raise fares, rationalise flights and maintain its long-term expansion plans, including the introduction of Airbus A350 aircraft in 2028.

items.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 1,288-cr
items.description: Aditya Birla Capital reported an impressive 38% profit increase for the September quarter of FY27, with profit after tax soaring to Rs 1,288 crore, up from Rs 933.52 crore year-over-year. Operational revenues also climbed significantly, reaching Rs 14,003 crore. Lending assets under management witnessed a robust 32% growth to Rs 2.34 lakh crore, while shares gained 1.75% on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

items.title: Asian Paints’ consolidated profit jumps 7.5% YoY in Q2
items.description: Asian Paints reported a 7.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 1,067.6 crore, while net sales grew 16.9% to Rs 9,953.9 crore. Higher raw material costs weighed on margins, prompting further staggered price hikes. The company also declared a dividend of Rs 5.75 per share.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 1,989 crore on exceptional charges
items.description: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Revenue from operations rose 12% YoY to Rs 16,199 crore from Rs 14,478 crore in Q2 of last financial year, supported by strong growth in its domestic formulations business and emerging markets.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
items.description: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.

items.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
items.description: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

items.title: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit drops 40% to Rs 46 crore as EBITDA margin contracts to 3.2%
items.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 40% decline in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating revenue increased by 13%, largely due to growth in subscription revenue supported by the FIFA World Cup 2026. Total expenditure rose by 18% primarily driven by increased programming and promotional costs. ZEE5, the company's streaming platform, showed significant growth by doubling its revenue year-on-year.

items.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
items.description: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

items.title: Spandana Sphoorty returns to profit at Rs 18 crore in Q2FY27
items.description: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
items.description: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

items.title: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
items.description: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

items.title: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
items.description: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

items.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
items.description: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

items.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
items.description: Jio Q2 Results: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 8,389 crore in Q2 FY27, its first results after listing. Revenue grew 11% to Rs 40,475 crore, supported by subscriber additions, growth in digital services and a marginal increase in ARPU.

items.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
items.description: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56.2% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 137.5 crore, driven by 53.2% revenue growth. EBITDA margins improved, while new solar capacity boosted its operational renewable energy portfolio.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
items.description: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. Net interest income grew 9% to Rs 13,026 crore, while asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio declining to 1.78%. Global advances and deposits also recorded double-digit growth.
